title: Use personal GitHub identity for fantasy repository pushes
description:
## Context

The required push of the Full planning setup failed: git push -u origin master reported permission denied to DDC-Heartwood for DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant.git. This blocks publishing the planning state tracked by fantasy-p55, the epic for the initial product planning session.

The operator-authorized personal repository accepts the planning commits using the configured personal identity.

## Acceptance Criteria

The planning commits are pushed to DylanDelliColli/fantasy-assistant, the local branch tracks origin/master, and a normal repository-local push uses the authorized personal identity. Record validation and close this blocker.

title: Implement roster-aware draft state and recommendation rules
description:
## Context
Implement the approved local Sleeper draft assistant defined by docs/adr/0001-local-draft-assistant.md and AGENTS.md. User: Kijuuu, league 1389330057733865472, draft 1389330057733865473, user ID 1264288993504149504, roster 5, slot 1; 14-team half-PPR, 13-round snake. Recommendations only. Season management and automatic Sleeper actions are excluded.

## Story and outcome
US-DRAFT-02 and US-DRAFT-03: deterministic recommendations use accepted picks, reversible local corrections and the actual roster. A recorded own pick at 28 immediately changes advice and next selections to 29/56, including when opponent picks are still absent from the feed.

## Implementation contract
Implement src/draft/state.mjs exports reconcileDraft(previous,incoming), applyLocalAction(state,action), deriveEffectiveDraft(state,config); src/draft/roster.mjs exports assignRoster and completion feasibility; src/draft/recommend.mjs exports recommend(snapshot,effectiveState). They are pure functions: no network, disk, randomness or model calls. Reuse the shared records created by fantasy-p55.5; extend src/contracts.mjs only for the declared state/result shapes. The full schedule is [1,28,29,56,57,84,85,112,113,140,141,168,169], from one-based snake arithmetic and roster5/slot1.

State keeps accepted=null before a validated or saved snapshot exists; accepted={picks:[],...} is a known empty draft and permits pick-1 recommendations. Otherwise it keeps accepted full picks, pending non-extension with revision/diff, local corrections with IDs, next selections and source/check/change/error metadata. Initial/unchanged-prefix extension is accepted; unchanged snapshots update check metadata only. Smaller or changed existing player/owner is held for review, never silently rolled back or appended to the old list. A changed configuration requires preparing again. Incoming request sequences/revisions cannot overwrite a newer local action or accepted fetch.

taken(playerId) excludes availability only. my-pick(playerId,pickNo) must be the next unfilled own selection and affects effective roster/next picks, without inventing opponent picks or altering official count. Reject duplicate/unknown players, invalid/occupied/non-owned/out-of-sequence slots and obsolete expectedRevision. Official confirmation removes exactly one matching correction; conflicting accepted ownership wins with a visible reason and recomputation. Undo removes only the named local correction; it cannot undo an official pick. accept-pending must name the current pending revision, then rebuild accepted state and clear my-pick corrections at/after first changed pick and every unassigned taken marker; report what was cleared. Unknown opponent IDs are unavailable; unknown own identities disable personalized advice but retain browsing.

Roster assignment is a maximum matching over actual starting slots. Each player fills one slot; FLEX accepts RB/WR/TE. Among maximum assignments, prefer dedicated slots before FLEX, then stable slot/player order. Four bench places and 13 selections; reserve is not drafted capacity. For every candidate, require completion with remaining selections and distinct eligible available players, respecting policy caps. Caps count each player's canonical policyPosition once: do not add second K/DEF or third QB/TE; existing excess in a position does not reject unrelated candidates.

Recommendation order: hard eligibility/availability/feasibility/caps first; outermost ordering groups are ordinary candidates, then deferred backup QB/TE, then early K/DEF. Apply this grouping before ECR tier/rank, missing-ECR placement or ADP bands. A dual-eligible player filling any offensive starter is not a deferred backup. K/DEF deferral lifts on final two own selections; it is ordering, not unconditional exclusion. Within each deferral group in ECR mode, sort ranked candidates by tier, fills-starter, ECR rank, ADP, string ID; missing ECR follows ranked players in that same group by ADP, never fake tiers. ADP-only mode uses fixed prepared bands of 12, then starter fit, exact ADP, ID; draft removals never recompute bands. Projected points/history/weekly injury tags do not change this ranking or imply health/per-game/survival claims.

Return up to three distinct candidates surviving all hard rules, with exact source and roster reasons, own roster/next picks, and unavailable/complete reasons as needed. If accepted is null, availability is unknown; a validated accepted snapshot with zero picks has known availability and receives normal first-pick advice. If own identity/configuration is unresolved or completion impossible, return no confident shortlist and retain the browseable board; do not pad. With no own selections remaining, show completed summary.

## File footprint

Roster: RB/WR/FLEX with dual RB+WR, RB-only and TE-only must fill WR/RB/FLEX respectively; one dual player cannot fill two slots; dedicated slot wins stable tie; two missing RB/WR cannot be filled by one dual; bench/reserve arithmetic and one policy position per player.
Recommendations: assert 0/1/2/3 distinct survivors, every hard exclusion, same-tier WR starter fit over later-needed RB when RB/FLEX full, no ordinary cross-tier need boost, unranked after ranked, fixed ADP12/13 boundary and tied IDs after earlier removals, backup versus dual-starter exception, early versus final-two K/DEF ordering, ordinary unranked RB before an early deferred ECR-ranked DEF and same-group unranked after ranked, caps with unrelated candidates unaffected, 11 own players missing K/DEF force those positions, impossible completion preserves browsing, raw points/injury tags cannot invent ordering penalties/health/per-game/odds. Identical inputs produce identical candidates/reasons. Assert initial unknown and complete results separately. Include one full400-player calculation.

A real invalid/gapped/failed response is rejected without clearing the last usable state. Replay a non-extension through pending review and exact adoption. title: Serve a persistent draft board with bounded Sleeper refresh
description:
## Context
Implement the approved local Sleeper draft assistant defined by docs/adr/0001-local-draft-assistant.md and AGENTS.md. All application paths listed below are new unless an earlier required bead creates them. User: Kijuuu, league 1389330057733865472, draft 1389330057733865473, user ID 1264288993504149504, roster 5, slot 1; 14-team half-PPR, 13-round snake. Recommendations only. Season management and automatic Sleeper actions are excluded.

## Story and outcome
US-DRAFT-02/03: one local process serves an immediately readable board while refreshing Sleeper in the background, saves corrections reliably, retains usable data on failure, and restores it after restart.

## Implementation contract
Implement src/session.mjs openSession(options) -> {getBoard,refresh,act,close} and src/server.mjs createApp({session,assetsDirectory}) plus the npm start entry. The session owns state revision, one refresh loop, process lock, source snapshot, serialized persistence, and BoardView. Domain rules remain in the previous bead; browser never owns another copy. Use real src/data/snapshot.mjs file helpers and src/sleeper/client.mjs HTTP. Clock/scheduler and upstream URLs can be supplied in-process to integration fixtures; production defaults are ordinary time and verified Sleeper routes.

Load the valid private snapshot/saved session before background refresh; restored boards are marked stale. With accepted=null (no validated or saved acceptance), availability is unknown. A validated or restored accepted snapshot with picks=[] is known empty and supports pick-1 advice, with stale status after restart until checked. Validate context at startup and explicit context refresh; inspect draft identity/shape each cycle. Network failure preserves saved data with failure metadata. A supported configuration change cannot silently reuse old rules: show prepare-required and disable confident personalized advice while retaining browsing. Unknown/corrupt schema or wrong saved config preserves file bytes and reports recovery, never overwrites blindly.

BoardView.revision remains the persisted domain/action token used by expectedRevision. Each openSession creates a fresh sessionId and a viewRevision counter; viewRevision advances whenever the observable board changes, including unchanged successful checks, failure/recovery, pending metadata and committed actions. Metadata-only updates leave the durable revision unchanged and cannot cause action conflicts. Browser comparison uses sessionId/viewRevision; these fields are not restored as durable revision values.

Only one process may own .local/drafts/<draftId>; exclusive lock records PID, and stale recovery requires proving PID dead (EPERM means do not assume dead). Serialize state mutations and atomic session.json writes. Commit accepted picks, corrections and revision as one value; acknowledge a local action only after it persists. On failure retain the previous durable state and expose structured error. An arriving refresh cannot interleave into half-written action state. Close stops timers/listeners and removes only this process's lock.

Refresh is single-flight per session, not per browser. Five seconds after valid success starts the next cycle; four-second deadlines per draft/picks request; 10/20/40/60/60 failure delays, longer valid Retry-After honored, success resets. Manual Refresh joins the current cycle and cannot bypass its retry deadline. Completed drafts poll30s to observe undo/reopen. A fetch started on an older revision cannot overwrite a later local action or accepted result. Apply the pure reconcile/action rules from fantasy-p55.6, including exact pending revision adoption. Check timestamps, observed-change timestamps and source times stay distinct; error appears immediately. Check age>=15s is overdue during pre-draft/in-progress; completed drafts use>=40s so a healthy30s cycle plus bounded requests does not appear overdue. Failure remains immediate at either cadence, and observing reopen restores the15s threshold.

HTTP: bind127.0.0.1:3000 by default; tests listen on port0. GET /api/board returns current BoardView with Cache-Control:no-store without waiting for upstream. POST /api/refresh queues/joins background work and returns202 with retry/inflight metadata. POST /api/actions consumes {expectedRevision,action} and returns200 plus new board after save; 409 obsolete revision, 422 invalid action, 500 structured persistence failure. Malformed JSON400, body>16KiB413, unsupported content type415, unknown route404, unsupported method405. JSON errors contain {error:{code,message},revision} and no raw stack/path/provider body. Mutations require Host matching local app hostname/port; if Origin exists, require exact local origin. Missing Origin is allowed for a local non-browser client; do not add permissive CORS.

Static allowlist: / and /index.html -> web/index.html, /app.mjs, /styles.css. Use fixed mappings, no arbitrary path joining/proxy. Before UI exists, integration passes a real temporary assets directory with a tiny harmless fixture; do not create placeholder production UI files. Reject private paths, traversal/encoded traversal, foreign Host/Origin on mutation, and all upstream write attempts. Render/serve normalized provider text only through safe browser text handling in next bead; no provider HTML is an asset.

## File footprint
src/session.mjs, src/server.mjs, src/contracts.mjs, src/data/snapshot.mjs, tests/helpers/runtime.mjs, tests/helpers/upstream.mjs, tests/unit/session.test.mjs, tests/integration/draft-sync.test.mjs, tests/integration/session-persistence.test.mjs, tests/integration/app.test.mjs, README.md, .beads/issues.jsonl.

## Unit test contract

Use controlled clock/scheduler, not wall-clock sleeps. Existing pure state and snapshot tests must keep passing; add assertions if shared validation/write behavior changes.

## Integration test contract
Extend tests/integration/draft-sync.test.mjs from fantasy-p55.6 with the real session/client/recommendation composition, retaining existing replay assertions, including unknown initial availability versus a successfully accepted empty draft. Use real loopback HTTP and controlled response barriers for500/429/hanging/malformed/gapped responses, no loss of usable state, healthy completed30s checks do not become overdue and observed reopen restores active cadence/threshold, older poll finishing after a newer correction, and pending rollback acceptance with current token only.
session-persistence.test.mjs uses real temp files: save/close/restart restores revision/picks/corrections as stale with a new sessionId and reset view counter, later official confirmation does not double-count; a second real process is refused without writes; dead PID recovery versus live ownership; corruptJSON/wrong schema/wrong config preserve bytes; conflicting filesystem destination/rename failure prevents acknowledgement; deferred persistence plus incoming HTTP response serializes without lost state. Do not substitute mocked fs/storage or rely on chmod.

GET-only provider request log and absence of generic proxy/write routes are negative assertions. Ensure every listener/process/timer is closed.

## Acceptance Criteria
Local HTTP serves real BoardView independently of provider latency; corrections are durable before acknowledgement; restarts/failures/conflicts are explicit and retain usable data. No second writer or stale response corrupts the board. Both unit and real HTTP/filesystem/process integration pass, full suite measured within30s.
